626e24f8d1d1.zh: 反向傳播能高效算梯度，但每步都要對全部 $n$ 筆資料求平均（Full-Batch），資料量大時算力完全吃不消。隨機梯度下降（SGD）每次只隨機抽一筆 $i$，用單樣本梯度近似全體梯度——計算廉價、具備擴充套件性，是深度學習最佳化法的基石鼻祖！
626e24f8d1d1.en: Backpropagation computes gradients efficiently, but every step still has to average over all $n$ data points (full batch), and when the data is large the compute simply can't keep up. Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) randomly draws just one sample $i$ each time and uses that single-sample gradient to approximate the gradient over all the data: cheap to compute and scalable, it is the founding cornerstone of optimization in deep learning!

609544387d8d.zh:
「用有雜訊的單一筆資料梯度更新，為什麼走得更快、模型更好？」 全資料梯度精確但昂貴，單樣本梯度粗糙但極其廉價！「貴的正確不如便宜的大概對」，隨機噪聲更是逃出鞍點與局部極小的神賜跳板！
Why does updating with a noisy single-sample gradient make training vastly faster and often generalize better? Cheap noisy approximations beat expensive perfection!
609544387d8d.en: "Why does updating with the noisy gradient of a single data point go faster and give a better model?" The full-data gradient is exact but expensive; the single-sample gradient is rough but extremely cheap! "Expensive and exactly right loses to cheap and roughly right," and the random noise is even a god-given springboard for escaping saddle points and local minima!

30a580b315a4.zh: 傳統數值最佳化（如精確最陡下降法或牛頓法）追求每一步都沿著嚴格精準的負梯度方向前進。 但在巨量資料時代，「計算一次精確全梯度的時間，足夠讓單樣本更新走上百萬步」！ 若每一步只抽樣少數甚至單一樣本，即使方向稍有偏差，但累積的位移依然能以極高速度衝向最優谷底。
30a580b315a4.en: Traditional numerical optimization (such as exact steepest descent or Newton's method) insists that every step move strictly along the exact negative gradient direction. But in the era of massive data, "the time it takes to compute one exact full gradient is enough for single-sample updates to take a million steps"! If each step samples only a few samples, or even a single one, then even though the direction is a little off, the accumulated displacement still rushes toward the bottom of the optimal valley at very high speed.

6734e72398fc.zh:
核心概念拆解：
• 抽樣索引 $i$： 在第 $k$ 步迭代中，自全體集合 $\{1, \dots, n\}$ 獨立且均勻隨機抽取一個樣本。
• 單樣本梯度 $\nabla f_i(\boldsymbol{w}^{(k)})$： 僅針對第 $i$ 筆資料執行一次前向與反向求導，完全不碰其餘 $n-1$ 筆！
• 學習率 $\eta^{(k)}$： 隨迭代步數 $k$ 自適應變動的步長排程。
• 複雜度飛躍： 每步計算代價由 $O(n)$ 驟降為 $O(1)$，實現對資料集規模的無限擴充套件性。
6734e72398fc.en:
The core concepts, broken down:
• Sampled index $i$: at iteration $k$, one sample is drawn independently and uniformly at random from the full set $\{1, \dots, n\}$.
• Single-sample gradient $\nabla f_i(\boldsymbol{w}^{(k)})$: one forward pass and one backward differentiation on data point $i$ only, without touching the other $n-1$ at all!
• Learning rate $\eta^{(k)}$: a step-size schedule that changes adaptively with the iteration count $k$.
• A leap in complexity: the cost per step drops from $O(n)$ to $O(1)$, giving unlimited scalability in the size of the dataset.

0d3f4e78a301.zh: 數學護航：單樣本梯度的期望無偏性保證 Mathematical Guarantee: The Unbiased Expectation $\mathbb{E}[\nabla f_i(\boldsymbol{w})] = \nabla f(\boldsymbol{w})$
0d3f4e78a301.en: Mathematical safeguard: the single-sample gradient is unbiased in expectation, $\mathbb{E}[\nabla f_i(\boldsymbol{w})] = \nabla f(\boldsymbol{w})$

11d25ac61d42.zh: 條件期望推導：統計無偏性
11d25ac61d42.en: Deriving the conditional expectation: statistical unbiasedness

4e2548f19dc4.en: Let the sampled index $i$ follow the discrete uniform distribution $P(i = j) = \frac{1}{n}$. Take the expectation of the single-sample gradient with respect to the sampling distribution:

b9df8233f0e8.zh: 深刻內涵： 單樣本梯度雖然每步都帶有隨機偏斜，但其期望方向嚴格等於真實全梯度！統計學上這稱為「無偏估計量（Unbiased Estimator）」。
b9df8233f0e8.en: The deeper meaning: although the single-sample gradient carries a random deviation at every step, its expected direction is exactly equal to the true full gradient! In statistics this is called an "unbiased estimator".

2c90f2996f67.zh: 雜訊正交分解：漂移項與擴散項
2c90f2996f67.en: Orthogonal decomposition of the noise: the drift term and the diffusion term

c2fb34f09ce6.zh: 我們可以將單步梯度嚴格分解為「真梯度 + 零均值擾動」：
c2fb34f09ce6.en: We can decompose the single-step gradient exactly into "true gradient + zero-mean perturbation":

53ec86e7ffaf.zh:
• 漂移項（Drift）： 真實負梯度驅使參數朝著總體最優點穩定推進。
• 擴散項（Diffusion）： 隨機雜訊 $\boldsymbol{\xi}_i$ 在周圍引發布朗運動般的隨機遊走，賦予演算法跳脫尖銳局部極小與鞍點的關鍵能力！
53ec86e7ffaf.en:
• Drift term: the true negative gradient drives the parameters steadily toward the overall optimum.
• Diffusion term: the random noise $\boldsymbol{\xi}_i$ sets off a Brownian-motion-like random walk around it, which gives the algorithm the key ability to escape sharp local minima and saddle points!

f19dfb9eb5ea.zh: 為什麼「無偏性」是 SGD 的定海神針？
f19dfb9eb5ea.en: Why is "unbiasedness" the anchor that keeps SGD steady?

2b786587e415.zh:
如果抽樣是有偏的（例如某類樣本被不成比例地多抽，且未做加權校正），期望方向就會偏離真實全梯度，演算法可能收斂到錯誤的偽極小點。
      唯有在均勻隨機抽樣保證下，大數法則與鞅差序列（Martingale Difference Sequence）理論才能生效，確保參數即使走得曲折，最終仍會邁向正確的終點！
2b786587e415.en: If the sampling is biased (for example, some kind of sample is drawn disproportionately often with no weighting correction), the expected direction drifts away from the true full gradient, and the algorithm may converge to a wrong, spurious minimum. Only under the guarantee of uniform random sampling do the law of large numbers and the theory of martingale difference sequences take effect, ensuring that even if the parameters take a winding path, they still end up heading to the right destination!

a0d9529f7d37.en: Cause and effect: single-step deviation and statistical convergence

18d1224995e2.zh:
為什麼單步會偏？
每個樣本 $f_i$ 都有其局部的幾何坡度。單一筆樣本只反映了資料空間的一個微小切片，因此單步向量 $\nabla f_i(\boldsymbol{w})$ 必然與總體梯度 $\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w})$ 產生夾角（單步偏斜雜訊）。
18d1224995e2.en:
Why does a single step deviate?
Every sample $f_i$ has its own local geometric slope. A single sample reflects only a tiny slice of the data space, so the single-step vector $\nabla f_i(\boldsymbol{w})$ inevitably makes an angle with the overall gradient $\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w})$ (single-step deviation noise).

c22d87bfcfa8.zh:
為什麼整體仍向前進？
只要抽樣是隨機均勻的，根據向量合成定則，數十次或數百次隨機更新的淨位移，其橫向雜訊分量會彼此正負抵消，而沿著負梯度方向的前進分量會同向疊加！
c22d87bfcfa8.en:
Why does it still move forward overall?
As long as the sampling is uniformly random, then by the rule of vector addition, in the net displacement of dozens or hundreds of random updates the sideways noise components cancel each other out, while the forward components along the negative gradient add up in the same direction!

4bd10ce4c50d.zh:
反直覺的泛化優勢（Generalization Benefit）：
精確全梯度往往會精準掉入狹窄且陡峭的「尖銳極小值（Sharp Minima）」中，導致過擬合。SGD 的隨機雜訊如同「天然的正則化振動器」，能輕易震出銳利坑洞，最終墜入寬闊平坦的「平坦極小值（Flat Minima）」，在未見測試集上表現更佳！
4bd10ce4c50d.en:
The counterintuitive generalization benefit:
The exact full gradient often drops precisely into narrow, steep "sharp minima", leading to overfitting. SGD's random noise acts like a "natural regularizing shaker": it easily shakes the parameters out of sharp pits so that they finally settle into wide, flat "flat minima", which perform better on the unseen test set!

b3e05395f07b.zh: 自適應學習率排程：固定 vs $1/k$ vs $1/\sqrt{k}$ Learning Rate Schedules: Fixed Step Size vs $1/k$ vs $1/\sqrt{k}$ Annealing
b3e05395f07b.en: Adaptive learning-rate schedules: fixed vs $1/k$ vs $1/\sqrt{k}$

c8940aca75ce.zh: 在全資料梯度下降中，若學習率滿足 $\eta < 2/L$（$L$-光滑條件），採用固定步長就能嚴格收斂到極值點 $\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w}^*) = \mathbf{0}$。 然而，在單樣本 SGD 中，即使到達極值點，單樣本梯度 $\nabla f_i(\boldsymbol{w}^*)$ 通常並不為零！ 若步長不隨時間衰減，隨機雜訊將永遠推擠參數在最優點周圍跳動。
c8940aca75ce.en: In full-data gradient descent, if the learning rate satisfies $\eta < 2/L$ (the $L$-smoothness condition), a fixed step size converges exactly to the extremum $\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w}^*) = \mathbf{0}$. In single-sample SGD, however, even once it reaches the extremum, the single-sample gradient $\nabla f_i(\boldsymbol{w}^*)$ is usually not zero! If the step size does not decay over time, the random noise will keep pushing the parameters to jump around the optimum forever.

1a7e0e03f26a.zh:
• 機制： 實作最為簡單直接，整段訓練全程維持固定步長。
• 行為特徵： 早期能極快抵達最優點附近的吸引盆（Attraction Basin）。
• 收斂瓶頸： 無法精確收斂至極小點，最終會停留在半徑為 $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ 的隨機擾動球（Noise Ball / Limit Cycle）內持續震盪。
• 折衷策略： 實務中常透過手動階梯式衰減（Step Decay）來壓低震盪半徑。
1a7e0e03f26a.en:
• Mechanism: the simplest and most direct to implement; the step size stays fixed throughout training.
• Behavior: early on it reaches the attraction basin near the optimum very quickly.
• Convergence bottleneck: it cannot converge exactly to the minimum; in the end it keeps oscillating inside a noise ball (limit cycle) of radius $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$.
• Compromise: in practice, a manual step decay is often used to shrink the oscillation radius.

cecd339d735b.zh:
• 機制： 步長與迭代次數 $k$ 成反比，隨步數增長快速遞減。
• 行為特徵： 早期大步跨越探索，後期步長迅速收縮以消弭抽樣雜訊。
• 理論重要性： 嚴格滿足 Robbins-Monro 隨機逼近條件，是古典隨機分析的標準研究原型。
• 實務痛點： 衰減速度過快，若初始常數未精心調校，容易在複雜非凸地貌中過早凍結（Premature freezing）。
cecd339d735b.en:
• Mechanism: the step size is inversely proportional to the iteration count $k$ and drops quickly as the steps go on.
• Behavior: big exploratory strides early on; later the step size shrinks rapidly to wipe out the sampling noise.
• Theoretical importance: it strictly satisfies the Robbins-Monro stochastic approximation conditions and is the standard prototype studied in classical stochastic analysis.
• Practical pain point: it decays too fast; if the initial constant is not carefully tuned, it easily freezes prematurely in a complex non-convex landscape.

0e9544ddf95c.zh:
• 機制： 衰減速率顯著慢於 $1/k$，維持較長週期的活躍探索動能。
• 理論保證： 在非平滑凸最佳化（Non-smooth Convex）理論中，此排程達到最佳的無約束收斂界限 $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{K})$。
• 實務評價： 兼具長程探索力與後期穩定性，在深度神經網路訓練排程中被極為廣泛地借鑒與應用。
0e9544ddf95c.en:
• Mechanism: it decays markedly more slowly than $1/k$, keeping up active exploratory momentum for a longer period.
• Theoretical guarantee: in the theory of non-smooth convex optimization, this schedule attains the optimal unconstrained convergence bound $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{K})$.
• Practical verdict: it combines long-range exploration with late-stage stability, and it is very widely borrowed and applied in training schedules for deep neural networks.

c6740771f191.zh: 排程選擇的本質：探索（Exploration）與開採（Exploitation）的平衡儀
c6740771f191.en: The essence of choosing a schedule: a balance between exploration and exploitation

f0e61fe76e66.zh:
早期離最優點遙遠時，梯度訊號強大，大步長 $\eta$ 能實現「高價效比的空間探索」；
      後期逼近谷底時，雜訊方差超越了真實梯度訊號，唯有透過步長衰減才能抑制方差「進行精細開採」。
f0e61fe76e66.en: Early on, far from the optimum, the gradient signal is strong, and a large step size $\eta$ gives "cost-effective exploration of the space"; later, close to the bottom of the valley, the noise variance exceeds the true gradient signal, and only step-size decay can suppress the variance to allow "fine-grained exploitation".

92fb96cd24bc.zh: 收斂條件：Robbins-Monro 準則的深層哲理 Classical Stochastic Approximation: The Depth of Robbins-Monro Conditions
92fb96cd24bc.en: Convergence conditions: the deeper philosophy of the Robbins-Monro criteria

886b5888dd34.zh: 條件一：能量無限（發散性保證）

f33ea0a4efd0.zh: 物理直覺： 步長的累積總和必須發散到無限大。這保證了無論初始參數 $\boldsymbol{w}^{(0)}$ 距離全域性最優點多麼遙遠，演算法總有足夠的「累積行進能力」抵達目的地，不會因為步長萎縮過早而半路凍結癱瘓。
f33ea0a4efd0.en: Physical intuition: the cumulative sum of the step sizes must diverge to infinity. This guarantees that no matter how far the initial parameters $\boldsymbol{w}^{(0)}$ are from the global optimum, the algorithm always has enough "cumulative travel capacity" to reach its destination, instead of freezing halfway because the step size shrank too early.

dedaee573e0b.zh: 條件二：方差有限（平方可和保證）

cd49c49ee0c2.zh: 物理直覺： 步長的平方和必須收斂為有限值。由於每步隨機雜訊引入的方差與 $(\eta^{(k)})^2$ 成正比，此條件確保了隨機遊走的總方差能量有限，從而在極限處徹底消弭跳動，實現幾乎必然收斂（Almost Sure Convergence）！
cd49c49ee0c2.en: Physical intuition: the sum of the squared step sizes must converge to a finite value. Since the variance injected by the random noise at each step is proportional to $(\eta^{(k)})^2$, this condition ensures that the total variance energy of the random walk is finite, so the jumping dies out completely in the limit, giving almost sure convergence!

fbcef39eb728.zh: 調和級數的數學巧合：為什麼 $\eta^{(k)} = 1/k$ 是教科書典範？
fbcef39eb728.en: A mathematical coincidence of the harmonic series: why is $\eta^{(k)} = 1/k$ the textbook example?

f3642d1b1cbf.zh:
古典微積分中著名的調和級數恰好滿足這兩個看似互相矛盾的條件：
• 發散性：$\sum_{k=1}^\infty \frac{1}{k} = 1 + \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{3} + \dots = \infty$（保證能量無限！能走任意遠）
• 平方可和性：$\sum_{k=1}^\infty \frac{1}{k^2} = 1 + \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{9} + \dots = \frac{\pi^2}{6} < \infty$（巴塞爾問題，保證方差有限！最終能靜止）
相反地，$1/\sqrt{k}$ 的平方和 $\sum \frac{1}{k} = \infty$，雖然在有限步內表現優異，但若不人為截斷或微調，理論上平方和發散，無法滿足古典 Robbins-Monro 的無條件漸近收斂。
f3642d1b1cbf.en:
The famous harmonic series of classical calculus happens to satisfy both of these seemingly contradictory conditions:
• Divergence: $\sum_{k=1}^\infty \frac{1}{k} = 1 + \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{3} + \dots = \infty$ (unlimited energy guaranteed! it can travel arbitrarily far)
• Square-summability: $\sum_{k=1}^\infty \frac{1}{k^2} = 1 + \frac{1}{4} + \frac{1}{9} + \dots = \frac{\pi^2}{6} < \infty$ (the Basel problem; finite variance guaranteed! it eventually comes to rest)
By contrast, for $1/\sqrt{k}$ the sum of squares is $\sum \frac{1}{k} = \infty$; although it performs very well over a finite number of steps, unless it is artificially truncated or fine-tuned, its sum of squares diverges in theory, and it cannot satisfy the unconditional asymptotic convergence of the classical Robbins-Monro conditions.

323ff9943caf.en: The "SGD" of everyday deep learning is really mini-batch SGD (§4.1 / KP08)

49fe308283ab.zh: • 嚴格單樣本 ($B=1$)：理論優雅，但現代硬體（GPU/TPU）執行單純純量操作會嚴重浪費平行計算能力。
49fe308283ab.en: • Strict single-sample ($B=1$): theoretically elegant, but on modern hardware (GPU/TPU) running pure scalar operations badly wastes parallel compute.

4546546a219b.zh: • 小批次 ($B=32\sim 256$)：用一小批平均梯度平衡「向量化吞吐」與「隨機探索」，方差縮小 B 倍，下一節 KP08 將深入解析！
4546546a219b.en: • Mini-batch ($B=32\sim 256$): the average gradient of a small batch balances "vectorized throughput" against "random exploration" and cuts the variance by a factor of B; the next section, KP08, analyzes it in depth!

deb515a93b80.zh: 小批次梯度方差縮小律
deb515a93b80.en: The mini-batch gradient variance reduction law

fabd8626fd1f.zh:
實務工程洞察：
1. 單樣本 SGD 的極限： 每步只抓一筆資料算梯度，計算極快，但在 GPU 核心啟動（Kernel Launch Overhead）與記憶體頻寬面前，無法發揮 SIMD 矩陣加速器的威力。
2. 現代架構折衷： 透過引入批次大小 $B$，在單步時間幾乎不增加的前提下（因 GPU 平行計算批次資料），使梯度估計的方差顯著縮小 $B$ 倍！
3. 過渡意義： 本節 KP07 建立的單樣本原理（無偏性、雜訊幾何、步長衰減）是理解後續所有批次演算法與自適應動量最佳化器（Adam, RMSprop）的不可或缺核心！
fabd8626fd1f.en:
Practical engineering insights:
1. The limits of single-sample SGD: each step grabs only one data point to compute the gradient, which is extremely fast, but faced with GPU kernel launch overhead and memory bandwidth, it cannot unleash the power of SIMD matrix accelerators.
2. The compromise of modern architectures: introducing a batch size $B$ cuts the variance of the gradient estimate markedly, by a factor of $B$, while barely increasing the time per step (because the GPU computes the batch data in parallel)!
3. Transitional significance: the single-sample principles established in this section, KP07 (unbiasedness, noise geometry, step-size decay), are the indispensable core for understanding all the batch algorithms and adaptive momentum optimizers (Adam, RMSprop) that follow!

67849ead914b.zh: 這份對比矩陣清晰展示了從傳統數值最佳化走向現代深度學習的哲學翻轉：「以統計雜訊換取計算時間，以隨機波動換取泛化能力」。 The shift from Full-Batch GD to SGD represents a paradigm inversion: trading deterministic precision for extreme computational scalability, and using stochastic noise to escape sharp local minima.
67849ead914b.en: This comparison matrix clearly shows the philosophical reversal in going from traditional numerical optimization to modern deep learning: "trade statistical noise for computation time, and random fluctuation for generalization ability".

04a0d421f14e.zh: 10 / 智慧結晶 · Master Laws of SGD

cda8ee19f49a.zh: 大師箴言：隨機梯度下降四大鐵律 The Four Inviolable Laws of Stochastic Gradient Descent
cda8ee19f49a.en: The master's maxims: the four iron laws of stochastic gradient descent

31b6d61028f3.zh: 一、貴正不如廉概律：便宜粗糙勝過昂貴完美
31b6d61028f3.en: Law 1, cheap beats exact: cheap and rough wins over expensive and perfect

dca6f62d417c.zh: 花費巨大代價算一步精準全梯度，不如用相同算力走上萬步「大致對」的隨機步。在遠離最優點的早期階段，高頻率的粗糙更新推進速度呈指數級勝出。
dca6f62d417c.en: Rather than pay an enormous price to compute one step of the exact full gradient, use the same compute to take tens of thousands of "roughly right" random steps. In the early phase, far from the optimum, frequent rough updates win by an exponential margin in speed of progress.

6435e8944826.zh: 二、無偏統計護航律：抽樣均勻則方向不迷航
6435e8944826.en: Law 2, the unbiased statistical escort: with uniform sampling, the direction never gets lost

ac174a71aed9.zh: 雖然單步隨機向量會偏斜，但只要抽樣獨立均勻，期望方向嚴格指向真實全梯度。大數法則與鞅論確保了長程路徑在統計上不會迷航。
ac174a71aed9.en: Although the random vector of a single step deviates, as long as the sampling is independent and uniform, the expected direction points exactly at the true full gradient. The law of large numbers and martingale theory ensure that the long-run path does not get lost, statistically speaking.

b8a836810e2e.zh: 三、步長退火收斂律：衰減退火方能消弭遊走
b8a836810e2e.en: Law 3, annealed convergence: only an annealed, decaying step size ends the wandering

958641f7995e.zh: 在最優點處，單樣本梯度永不為零。固定步長必然在最優點周圍 $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ 鄰域震盪徘徊；唯有遵從 Robbins-Monro 條件逐漸降低步長，才能鎖定全域性極小。
958641f7995e.en: At the optimum, the single-sample gradient is never zero. A fixed step size is bound to oscillate and wander in an $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ neighborhood of the optimum; only by lowering the step size gradually, following the Robbins-Monro conditions, can it lock onto the global minimum.

929b26edf08d.zh: 四、噪聲泛化雙刃律：隨機擾動是正則化神賜
929b26edf08d.en: Law 4, the double edge of noise and generalization: random perturbation is a god-given regularizer

4d32f91532ea.zh: 單樣本的梯度雜訊不是瑕疵，而是神賜的隱式正則化！它像一把晃動的篩子，震出泛化差的尖銳坑洞，將模型沉澱到泛化能力卓越的平坦谷底。
4d32f91532ea.en: The gradient noise of single samples is not a flaw but a god-given implicit regularization! Like a shaking sieve, it shakes out the sharp pits that generalize poorly and lets the model settle onto flat valley floors with excellent generalization ability.

1c13fc2061be.zh:
4 樣本二次目標函式： $f(w) = \frac{1}{4} \sum_{i=1}^4 f_i(w) = \frac{1}{4} \sum_{i=1}^4 \frac{1}{2}(w - c_i)^2$，中心點分別為 $c = [1.0, 3.0, 5.0, 7.0]$。
全域性平均與最優點： 中心平均 $\bar{c} = \frac{1+3+5+7}{4} = 4.0$。總目標函式為 $f(w) = \frac{1}{2}(w - 4)^2 + 2.5$，全域性最優點嚴格位於 $w^* = 4.000$。
單樣本梯度 vs 全梯度： 單樣本梯度 $\nabla f_i(w) = w - c_i$；全梯度 $\nabla f(w) = \frac{1}{4} \sum (w - c_i) = w - 4.0$。
無偏期望檢驗： 4 筆樣本梯度之平均嚴格等於全梯度：$\frac{1}{4}\sum_{i=1}^4 (w - c_i) = w - 4 = \nabla f(w)$。
黃金基準檢驗： 重設後 $w = 0.000$，全梯度為 $\nabla f(0) = -4.0$。全梯度一步更新後新位置為：
$$ w^{(1)} = w^{(0)} - \eta \nabla f(0) = 0 - \eta (-4.0) = \eta \cdot 4.0 $$ 當預設步長 $\eta = 0.250$ 時，全梯度一步恰好到達 $w = 0.25 \times 4.0 = 1.000$！
1c13fc2061be.en:
4-sample quadratic objective: $f(w) = rac{1}{4} \sum_{i=1}^4 f_i(w) = rac{1}{4} \sum_{i=1}^4 rac{1}{2}(w - c_i)^2$, with centers $c = [1.0, 3.0, 5.0, 7.0]$.
Global average and optimum: the mean of the centers is $ ar{c} = rac{1+3+5+7}{4} = 4.0$. The overall objective is $f(w) = rac{1}{2}(w - 4)^2 + 2.5$, and the global optimum lies exactly at $w^* = 4.000$.
Single-sample gradient vs full gradient: the single-sample gradient is $ abla f_i(w) = w - c_i$; the full gradient is $ abla f(w) = rac{1}{4} \sum (w - c_i) = w - 4.0$.
Unbiased expectation check: the average of the 4 sample gradients equals the full gradient exactly: $ rac{1}{4}\sum_{i=1}^4 (w - c_i) = w - 4 = abla f(w)$.
Golden baseline check: after a reset, $w = 0.000$ and the full gradient is $ abla f(0) = -4.0$. After one full-gradient update, the new position is:
$$ w^{(1)} = w^{(0)} - \eta abla f(0) = 0 - \eta (-4.0) = \eta \cdot 4.0 $$ With the default step size $\eta = 0.250$, one full-gradient step lands exactly on $w = 0.25 imes 4.0 = 1.000$!

f1950bb1995a.zh: A. 每更新一步必須對全部 $n$ 筆資料執行前向反向傳播並求和，時間複雜度為 $O(n)$

cba107ee8c66.en: D. Only the derivatives of the output-layer weights are needed; the hidden layers cost nothing
